pages.title: Eight Modes
pages.text:
Combat: Melee (attacks hostile mobs, needs sword/axe) / Archer (uses bow/crossbow, auto-draws)

Gathering: Woodcutting (chainsaw-fells whole trees) / Mining (BFS ore scan + tunnel boring) / Fishing (auto-fish near water, excludes Follow)

Support: Farming (tills 9x9, plants, harvests) / Feeding (throws food to owner when hungry) / Torch Placing (places torches where light < 8)

pages.title: Switching Modes
pages.text:
Right-click with the Remote to open the control panel. Lists all living dolls. Click a button to switch modes. Click the active mode again to deselect.

• Follow toggle is independent of the 8 modes
• Fishing and Follow are mutually exclusive
• Changes take effect immediately
• Required tool must be in the doll's inventory
